prompt.content: Sometimes I just need someone who listens and understands. No one seems to have the time for me. Can you be that someone for me right now? Any advice or personal stories would mean a lot to me.

output:
I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. It can be incredibly isolating when it feels like no one is listening or understanding. You deserve someone who can give you the time and attention you need.

If you're comfortable, I’d be glad to listen and share a little of my own experience.
